diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-1 F4W71B transmission
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional longitudinal cutaway view of the complete F4W71B 4-speed manual transmission assembly, detailing the main drive gear, synchronizers, mainshaft gears, countershaft cluster, reverse idler gear, striking rod linkage, adapter plate, and housing structure.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Main drive gear meshes with counter drive gear; mainshaft is piloted in the main drive gear by needle bearings. Adapter plate supports center bearings.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-2 F4W71B transmission case components
diagrams.description: Exploded view diagram of the transmission case, adapter plate, bearing retainer, rear extension housing, front cover, gaskets, and attaching hardware.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay attention to dowel pin alignment between transmission case, adapter plate, and rear extension housing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-3 F4W71B transmission gear components
diagrams.description: Exploded view illustrating the gear train components of the F4W71B 4-speed transmission, including main drive gear, mainshaft gears, synchronizer assemblies, countershaft assembly, and reverse idler.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mainshaft nut should be discarded and replaced upon disassembly. Note correct order and orientation of synchronizer insert springs and shifting inserts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-4 F4W71B transmission shift control components
diagrams.description: Exploded view diagram of F4W71B internal shift linkage components, including striking lever, guide, striking rod, shift forks, fork rods, check balls, check springs, interlock balls, and control lever assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note orientation of check balls and interlock balls in the adapter plate to prevent dual engagement.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-5 Removing control lever
diagrams.description: Illustration showing removal of the transmission gearshift control lever by removing the E-ring and pin from the striking rod guide.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Place transmission control lever in neutral position before removing E-ring and control lever pin.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-6 Bottom view of car
diagrams.description: Underside view of vehicle showing disconnection locations for reverse lamp switch wiring, clutch operating cylinder, and speedometer cable.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove clutch operating cylinder and let it hang or tie out of way; disconnect speedometer cable before dropping rear extension.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-7 Removing propeller shaft
diagrams.description: Illustration of propeller shaft flange bolts removal at the transmission companion flange.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 3.5 to 4.5 kg-m (25 to 33 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten propeller shaft bolts to 3.5 to 4.5 kg-m (25 to 33 ft-lb) on reassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-8 Tightening torque
diagrams.description: Diagram illustrating tightening torque patterns and values for transmission bellhousing-to-engine bolts.
measurements_and_specs: Top transmission to engine bolts: 4.4 to 5.9 kg-m (32 to 43 ft-lb)
Bottom bolts (engine rear plate to transmission): 0.9 to 1.2 kg-m (6.5 to 8.7 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure proper torque distribution across upper heavy bellhousing bolts and lower sheet-metal rear plate bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-9 Removing striking rod E-ring and stopper pin
diagrams.description: Detailed illustration showing the removal of E-ring and stopper guide pin from the rear end of the transmission rear extension housing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove E-ring and pull stopper guide pin prior to removing rear extension housing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-10 Removing return spring plug
diagrams.description: Technician using a wrench to remove the return spring plug from the side of the rear extension housing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Keep track of return spring, reverse check spring, and plunger when plug is removed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-11 Removing rear extension
diagrams.description: Removing rear extension housing from adapter plate by lightly tapping with a soft mallet while turning the striking rod leftward.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn striking rod toward left to disengage striking lever before tapping rear extension off.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-12 Removing main drive bearing snap ring
diagrams.description: Using snap ring expander pliers to remove the large snap ring securing the main drive gear front bearing inside the transmission front case.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove front cover and countershaft front shim before expanding and removing main drive bearing snap ring.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-13 Removing transmission case
diagrams.description: Separating transmission bellhousing case from the adapter plate using a soft mallet.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tap case gently with soft hammer to break sealant bond without cracking aluminum mating flanges.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-14 Attaching gear assembly to special tool
diagrams.description: Mounting the adapter plate and gear train assembly onto Setting Plate Adapter ST23810001 clamped in a workbench vise.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mount assembly with countershaft side facing upwards in vise.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-15 Drive out retaining pins
diagrams.description: Technician using Fork Rod Pin Punch KV31100300 and a hammer to drive out roll pins securing shift forks to fork rods.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Retaining roll pins should be replaced with new pins upon reassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-16 Layout of check ball and interlock ball
diagrams.description: Cutaway diagram showing relative positions and channels of the three check balls, four interlock balls, and fork rods in the adapter plate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CRITICAL: Do not lose check balls or interlock balls. Note order: 1st/2nd fork rod, 2 interlock balls, 3rd/4th rod, 2 interlock balls, reverse rod.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-17 Removing countershaft front bearing
diagrams.description: Using a two-jaw gear puller to remove counter gear front bearing while transmission gears are doubly engaged to lock rotation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Engage two gears simultaneously (double engage) to prevent shaft rotation during puller operation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-18 Removing counter drive gear and main drive gear
diagrams.description: Pulling counter drive gear together with main drive gear off the shafts using a puller.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Take care not to allow the pilot needle bearing to drop from the front end of the mainshaft.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-19 Removing mainshaft nut
diagrams.description: Releasing lock staking on mainshaft rear nut and unscrewing the nut with a socket bar while gears are locked.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Unstake lock collar before loosening nut. Always discard used mainshaft nut; never reuse.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-20 Driving out gear assembly
diagrams.description: Technician supporting mainshaft gear assembly with one hand while tapping the rear end with a soft hammer to drive out mainshaft and counter gear together.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Carefully hold front of mainshaft assembly by hand while tapping to prevent the counter gear from dropping.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-21 Removing 1st gear bushing
diagrams.description: Using Bearing Puller ST30031000 under a hydraulic press to press off 1st gear mainshaft bushing along with 2nd gear and 1st & 2nd synchronizer assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold mainshaft by hand while pressing out bushing to prevent it from dropping onto the floor.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-22 Mainshaft assembly
diagrams.description: Exploded view diagram of the complete mainshaft assembly showing sequence of all gears, needle bearings, synchronizer assemblies, bushings, thrust washers, steel ball, main bearing, and nut.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pay strict attention to placement of steel ball (22) that locks thrust washer (17). Observe synchronizer hub front/rear orientation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-23 Removing main drive bearing
diagrams.description: Press setup showing Bearing Puller ST30031000 supporting the main drive bearing while the press ram drives out the main drive gear shaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove snap ring and spacer before pressing off bearing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-24 Removing countershaft bearing
diagrams.description: Press setup showing countershaft rear bearing removal using Bearing Puller ST30031000 under a shop press.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold shaft by hand so as not to allow countershaft to drop onto the shop floor when bearing releases.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-25 Inspecting ball bearing
diagrams.description: Hand inspection of a transmission ball bearing, slowly turning inner race by hand to detect roughness, axial play, or damaged balls/races.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not spin bearings with compressed air, as lack of lubrication at high speed damages races and balls.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-26 Measuring end play
diagrams.description: Using a flat feeler gauge (thickness gauge) inserted between gear faces on the mainshaft to measure axial end play.
measurements_and_specs: 1st gear end play: 0.32 to 0.39 mm (0.0126 to 0.0154 in)
2nd gear end play: 0.12 to 0.19 mm (0.0047 to 0.0075 in)
3rd gear end play: 0.13 to 0.37 mm (0.0051 to 0.0146 in)
Reverse counter gear end play: 0.01 to 0.20 mm (0.0004 to 0.0079 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure gear end play with feeler gauge while gears are installed on shaft.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-27 Baulk ring-to-cone gap
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional detail illustration showing measurement of the gap between the baulk ring face and the gear cone clutch surface.
measurements_and_specs: Standard gap: 1.2 to 1.6 mm (0.047 to 0.063 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold baulk ring firmly against gear cone when checking gap. If clearance is 0.8 mm (0.031 in) or less, baulk ring must be replaced.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-28 Front cover oil seal
diagrams.description: Cross section showing correct installation direction and lip orientation of front cover oil seal.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Press-fit oil seal with sealing lip facing inward/front as indicated by arrow; coat lip with gear oil prior to assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-29 Rear extension oil seal
diagrams.description: Cross section showing correct press-in orientation of the rear extension housing rear output oil seal.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Press-fit oil seal squarely into housing seat; apply grease to oil seal lip and bushing prior to driveshaft installation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-30 Oil gutter
diagrams.description: Illustration of the oil gutter installation and bending orientation on the adapter plate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bend oil gutter on front side and expand on rear side after positioning.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-31 Staking screw
diagrams.description: Using a center punch to stake bearing retainer attaching screws at two points on the adapter plate.
measurements_and_specs: Screw torque: 1.9 to 2.5 kg-m (14 to 18 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Torque screws to 1.9 to 2.5 kg-m (14 to 18 ft-lb) and stake each screw at two points to prevent loosening.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-32 Installing synchronizer hub
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional comparison showing correct front-to-rear installation orientation of 4th & 3rd synchronizer hub versus 2nd & 1st synchronizer hub.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Notice asymmetry of boss length between 3rd/4th and 1st/2nd synchronizer hubs. Assemble facing proper direction.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-33 Installing thrust washer
diagrams.description: Technician sliding thrust washer over 1st gear on the mainshaft, ensuring alignment with the locking steel ball.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply grease to steel ball to hold it in place on mainshaft before sliding thrust washer on.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-34 Transmission Press Stand
diagrams.description: Detailed diagram of Transmission Press Stand KV31100400 showing hole locations for counter gear, reverse idler shaft, and mainshaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Provides solid base for pressing mainshaft and countershaft into adapter plate bearings without cocking.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-35 Installing mainshaft assembly
diagrams.description: Press setup pressing mainshaft assembly into the center bearing on adapter plate supported on Press Stand KV31100400.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure bearing is square against shaft; press into place gradually.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-36 Installing counter gear
diagrams.description: Press setup showing counter gear being pressed into adapter plate rear bearing while assembly rests on Press Stand KV31100400.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support counter gear rear bearing properly on press stand during pressing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-37 Installing snap ring
diagrams.description: Installing snap ring in the front end groove of the mainshaft ahead of the 3rd & 4th synchronizer assembly thrust washer.
measurements_and_specs: Snap ring thickness: 1.4 mm, 1.5 mm, or 1.6 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Select snap ring of thickness that minimizes axial clearance in mainshaft groove.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-38 Installing counter drive gear
diagrams.description: Pressing counter drive gear onto counter gear using Counter Gear Drift ST23860000 while meshing gears.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CRITICAL: Counter drive gear and main drive gear must be driven on simultaneously with teeth meshed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-39 Installing snap ring
diagrams.description: Fitting counter drive gear retaining snap ring to front end groove of countershaft.
measurements_and_specs: Counter drive gear snap ring thickness: 1.4 mm, 1.5 mm, or 1.6 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Secure counter drive gear with the thickest snap ring that fits the groove.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-40 Installing counter gear front bearing
diagrams.description: Pressing counter gear front bearing onto countershaft using Bearing Drift ST22360002 on Press Stand KV31100400.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure bearing is pressed firmly against counter drive gear shoulder.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-41 Installing counter reverse gear snap ring
diagrams.description: Installing snap ring on rear end of countershaft to retain counter reverse gear with assembly mounted on Setting Plate Adapter ST23810001.
measurements_and_specs: Counter reverse gear snap ring thickness: 1.4 mm, 1.5 mm, or 1.6 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Select snap ring thickness that gives minimum gear end play (less than 0.20 mm).

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-42 Tightening mainshaft nut
diagrams.description: Tightening the mainshaft rear nut using Special Wrench ST22520000 attached to a click-type or beam-type torque wrench.
measurements_and_specs: Specified nut torque: 14.0 to 17.0 kg-m (101 to 123 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Gears must be doubly engaged to lock the shaft while torquing mainshaft nut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-43 Setting wrench
diagrams.description: Schematic diagram showing geometry of torque wrench with Special Wrench ST22520000 extension, defining effective length L and extension offset 0.10 m (0.33 ft).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Because ST22520000 extends the lever arm by 0.10 m (0.33 ft), wrench reading C is lower than actual applied torque at the nut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-44 Converted torque
diagrams.description: Nomograph chart plotting converted torque scale reading C (kg-m, ft-lb) against effective torque wrench length L (m, ft) with upper and lower limit tolerance lines.

callouts.C: Value read on the torque wrench (kg-m / ft-lb)
callouts.L: Effective length of torque wrench (m / ft)

measurements_and_specs: Target nut torque: 14 to 17 kg-m (101 to 123 ft-lb)
For L = 0.40 m: C = 11.2 to 13.6 kg-m (81 to 98 ft-lb)
For L = 0.50 m: C = 11.7 to 14.2 kg-m (84 to 103 ft-lb)
For L = 0.60 m: C = 12.0 to 14.6 kg-m (87 to 105 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Look up torque wrench length on horizontal axis to find required gauge reading range.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-45 Staking mainshaft nut
diagrams.description: Using a hammer and punch to stake the thin collar of the mainshaft nut into the groove of the mainshaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Stake nut securely into mainshaft spline groove to prevent backing off.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-46 Installing 1st & 2nd fork rod
diagrams.description: Sliding the 1st & 2nd fork rod through adapter plate bores and shift fork.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Align detent notches in rod with check ball bore. Use new roll pins.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-47 Installing 3rd & 4th fork rod
diagrams.description: Installing 3rd & 4th fork rod through adapter plate and 3rd & 4th shift fork.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CRITICAL: Install two interlock balls into adapter plate bore before inserting 3rd & 4th fork rod.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-48 Installing reverse fork rod
diagrams.description: Installing reverse shift fork and reverse fork rod through adapter plate.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install two interlock balls into adapter plate prior to inserting reverse fork rod. Check ball plug torque: 1.9 to 2.5 kg-m (14 to 18 ft-lb).

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-49 Fitting main drive bearing snap ring
diagrams.description: Using snap ring expander to seat large snap ring into the main drive bearing outer race groove through front case opening.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure snap ring is fully seated in outer race groove around its entire circumference.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-50 Selecting counter gear front bearing shim
diagrams.description: Diagram illustrating depth measurement dimension 'A' from front face of transmission case to the counter gear front bearing outer race for shim selection.

callouts.A: Measurement dimension from case front face to bearing face

measurements_and_specs: Dimension 'A' range: 2.92 to 3.71 mm (0.1150 to 0.1461 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Accurately measure depth 'A' using depth micrometer or vernier caliper to choose proper compensating shim.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-51 FS5W71B transmission
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional longitudinal cutaway view of FS5W71B 5-speed manual transmission showing overdrive gear arrangement behind adapter plate, servo synchro mechanism, and all internal shafts and gears.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: FS5W71B features Warner synchromesh on 1st-4th gears and Porsche-type servo synchromesh with band brake on 5th (overdrive) gear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-52 FS5W71B transmission case components
diagrams.description: Exploded view diagram of FS5W71B 5-speed transmission casing assemblies, front cover, adapter plate, rear extension housing, breather, and oil seals.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note breather vent location on top of rear extension housing and dust cover on rear sleeve yoke.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-53 FS5W71B transmission gear components
diagrams.description: Exploded view illustration of all gear train components of FS5W71B 5-speed transmission including overdrive main gear, overdrive synchronizer components, reverse gears, countershaft cluster, and reverse idler shaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Observe assembly sequence of OD brake band (17), thrust block (16), synchro ring (18), and circlip (15). Discard nuts 22 and 34 after removal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-54 FS5W71B transmission shift control components
diagrams.description: Exploded view diagram of FS5W71B shift control linkages, including striking lever, striking guide, striking rod, expansion plug, fork rods (including reverse & OD rod), and shift forks.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: FS5W71B features combined reverse & overdrive shift fork and fork rod. Expansion plug (7) seals rear end of striking rod bore.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-55 Removing counter gear nut
diagrams.description: Loosening counter gear nut at rear of countershaft with socket wrench while gears are doubly engaged.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Unstake locking flange before loosening. Counter gear nut and mainshaft nut must be discarded and never reused.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-56 Removing counter overdrive gear and bearing
diagrams.description: Drawing counter overdrive gear and rear ball bearing off the countershaft rear extension using a puller.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use a suitable puller engaged behind the bearing outer/inner race.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-57 Removing mainshaft rear bearing
diagrams.description: Using Mainshaft Rear Bearing Puller KV32101330 to draw the mainshaft rear ball bearing off the mainshaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove snap rings and speedometer gear before pulling mainshaft rear bearing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-58 Installing overdrive gear assembly
diagrams.description: Front face and sectional view of the Porsche-type servo overdrive synchronizer assembly showing placement of synchro ring, brake band, thrust block, anchor block, and circlip.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Carefully fit anchor block and thrust block into their respective recesses in the clutch gear before securing with circlip.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-59 Reverse idler gear
diagrams.description: Assembly cross-section and orientation of the reverse idler gear on its shaft with spacers, needle bearing, and retaining snap rings.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Verify forward facing orientation of reverse idler gear step and ensure snap rings are fully engaged in shaft grooves.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-60 Tightening mainshaft nut
diagrams.description: Tightening mainshaft lock nut on FS5W71B using Special Wrench ST22520000 with gears locked by double engagement.
measurements_and_specs: Counter gear lock nut torque: 10.0 to 13.0 kg-m (72 to 94 ft-lb)
Mainshaft lock nut converted torque formula: Fig. MT-44
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use Wrench ST22520000 and calculate converted torque based on torque wrench effective length.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-61 Staking mainshaft nuts
diagrams.description: Using hammer and punch to stake both the mainshaft lock nut and counter gear lock nut into shaft grooves.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Both nuts must be securely staked into the respective shaft locking notches.

diagrams.caption: Fig. MT-62 Assembling mainshaft rear bearing
diagrams.description: Driving mainshaft rear bearing onto mainshaft using Bearing Drift ST22350000 and hammer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Drive bearing squarely until seated against shoulder, then select thickest snap ring to eliminate axial play.

diagrams.caption: ST23810001 Setting plate adapter
diagrams.description: Setting plate adapter plate fixture for clamping transmission adapter plate securely in a workbench vise during disassembly and assembly.
measurements_and_specs: Reference: Fig. MT-14, Fig. MT-15, Fig. MT-41
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: ST22360002 Bearing drift
diagrams.description: Cylindrical bearing drift for pressing counter gear front bearing onto the countershaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: KV31100300 Fork rod pin punch
diagrams.description: Pin punch specifically sized for driving roll retaining pins into and out of shift forks and fork rods.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: ST22520000 Wrench
diagrams.description: Special offset torque wrench adapter socket for tightening mainshaft lock nut.
measurements_and_specs: Reference: Fig. MT-42, Fig. MT-43, Fig. MT-60
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models. Requires torque calculation conversion formula.

diagrams.caption: ST30031000 Bearing puller
diagrams.description: Split-plate bearing puller attachment for dismounting main drive bearing, countershaft bearing, and 1st gear bushing under a press.
measurements_and_specs: Reference: Fig. MT-21, Fig. MT-23, Fig. MT-24
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: KV32101330 Bearing puller
diagrams.description: Special puller assembly for drawing off mainshaft rear bearing on FS5W71B transmission.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Specific to FS5W71B 5-speed manual transmission.

diagrams.caption: KV31100400 Transmission press stand
diagrams.description: Multi-hole transmission press stand supporting the adapter plate and shafts during shop press operations.
measurements_and_specs: Reference: Fig. MT-34, Fig. MT-35, Fig. MT-36, Fig. MT-40
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: ST22350000 Mainshaft bearing drift
diagrams.description: Tubular drift sleeve used for driving the mainshaft rear bearing onto the mainshaft of FS5W71B transmission.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Specific to FS5W71B 5-speed manual transmission.

diagrams.caption: ST23860000 Counter gear drift
diagrams.description: Counter gear drift for pressing counter drive gear onto countershaft with gears meshed.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

diagrams.caption: ST23800000 Transmission adapter
diagrams.description: Transmission adapter drift sleeve for pressing main drive bearing onto the shaft of the main drive gear.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applicable to all S30 series models.

troubleshooting.symptom: Difficult to intermesh gears (heavy gear shift lever, difficult shifting, or unsmooth clutch disengagement)
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn gears, shaft, and/or bearing; Insufficient operating stroke due to worn or loose sliding part; Faulty or damaged synchronizer.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace worn gears, shaft, and/or bearing; Repair or replace sliding part; Replace faulty or damaged synchronizer.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn interlock ball; Worn check ball and/or weakened or broken spring; Worn fork rod ball groove; Worn or damaged bearing; Worn or damaged gear; Vibration generated by weakened front and rear engine mounts.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace worn interlock ball; Replace check ball and/or spring; Replace fork rod; Replace worn or damaged bearing; Replace worn or damaged gear; Inspect and replace engine mounts.

troubleshooting.symptom: Noise (occurs with engine idling and ceases when clutch disengaged, or occurs while shifting gears)
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Insufficient or improper lubricant; Oil leaking due to faulty oil seal or sealant, clogged breather, etc.; Worn bearing (High humming occurs at a high speed.); Damaged bearing (Cyclic knocking sound occurs also at a low speed.); Worn spline; Worn bushing.
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Add oil or replace with designated oil; Clean or replace oil seal, sealant, or breather; Replace worn bearing; Replace damaged bearing; Replace worn spline; Replace worn bushing. Note: If transmission rattles during engine idling, check air-fuel mixture and ignition timing, then readjust engine idling.
